d:
A story focusing on Jun Kagami (KOF EX2 exclusive character) and Shermie (regular in KOF series roster).

Title means "Lesbian love for wrestling grabbing"

Jun Kagami is sadly very obscure but she is a strong design, Japanese ganguro woman with a fashion style, great ass and hips, almost 2 meters tall, extreme powerful grappler... and you SNK NO MAKE HER SHERMIE REPLACEMENT IN KOF REGULAR SERIES?!

KOF EX2 was actually my very first KOF game (back between 2004 and 2007 when here in my shitty backward village we still had 56k landline internet connection, LOOOL), and it is a great KOF2000 reimaging with exclusive characters, great 16-bit ost and excellent gameplay.

Both Shermie and Jun are wrestlers (Shermie more graceful, Jun way more rough and power based) yet both also harbor hidden magical powers within, as both are heralds of Orochi (Japanese Serpent God).

The story is sort of a canon prequel to the KOF EX continuity, set between KOF1996 and KOF 1997, KOF EX sub-series diverging after KOF1997 into it's own continuity, which was still rooted into the lore of KOF1994 to KOF1997.
